sql.sql: CREATE INDEX "posts_created_at_id_idx" ON "posts" ("created_at","id");
BEGIN
CREATE INDEX "posts_created_at_id_idx" ON "posts" ("created_at","id");
COMMIT
select "id", "title", "created_at" from "posts" order by "posts"."created_at" asc, "posts"."id" asc limit $1

select "id", "title", "created_at" from "posts" where (("posts"."created_at" > $1) or ((("posts"."created_at" = $2) and ("posts"."id" > $3)))) order by "posts"."created_at" asc, "posts"."id" asc limit $4

select "id", "title", "created_at" from "posts" where (("posts"."created_at" > $1) or ((("posts"."created_at" = $2) and ("posts"."id" > $3)))) order by "posts"."created_at" asc, "posts"."id" asc limit $4
